# Tab Scrollbar Bug
Global CSS scrollbar styling in main.css added left/right arrows to all scrollbars, causing tab bar anomalies and last tab hidden in EstateManagement V0 project.

## Description
- Affects tab bar (#myTab) in EstateManagement-Base and EstateManagement-Park webapps.
- Last tab was squeezed out due to width:88.5% not filling and inaccurate offsetLeft calculation.

## Root Cause
- main.css global scrollbar style applied arrows to all scrollbars; tab bar inherited left arrow anomaly.
- width:88.5% left the bar non-full; offsetLeft calc inaccurate.

## Solution
- Hide arrows specifically for #myTab.
- Change tab bar to left:220px;right:0 to occupy full width.
- Use getBoundingClientRect for scroll logic and add scroll-padding-inline:20px to keep last tab visible.

# Paste Image Auto-upload Pattern
In EstateManagement Park Froala editor, pasted images are auto-uploaded and only server URL remains in body to avoid base64 bloat.

## Description
- afterPasteCallback converts pasted image to FormData and uploads to version/1/i.froala.com/upload.
- Body keeps only server URL, preventing base64 inflation that triggers update prompt.

## Implementation
- Added policy/js/policy_froalaPasteUpload.js (single image ≤10MB).
- Updated policy_SmPolicyCommunityRecordAdd.shtml and policy_SmPolicyCommunityRecordEdit.shtml to use pattern.

# Print Submit Flag Bug
mfap_MfapFinalSharePublicDetail.js shareDetailPrint() missing submitConTig=true caused submitForm() to block submission.

## Description
- In shareDetailPrint() success callback, submitConTig was not set true, unlike exportExcel() logic.
- submitForm() intercepts submit due to missing flag, causing submission failure.

## Solution
- Set this.submitConTig = true in success callback of shareDetailPrint() to align with exportExcel().
